title: When build is a threading enabled *DLINK* Web build, ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request will never report progress, stays THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS
body:
### Tested versions

I only really tested tip for this issue: v4.5.beta.custom_build [c2202d36c]

This only happens when using a dlink_enabled=yes build wIth threading.



### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (c2202d36c) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Single-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21013.1000) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.90 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request` with `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status` to get progress, progress will never develop past `ResourceLoader.ThreadLoadStatus.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS` 

When manually using `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get()` to finish up, the resource will be returned just fine though (but the app freezes when the resource takes a bit longer to load, indicating that likely, it just falls back to completely loading it synchronously)

This issue is kind of a follow-up to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109148 but I think may have nothing to do with that original issue. Before or after the fix of this original issue, both variants still break on the dlink build (while the nothreads build breaks regardless before the fix of that issue). It's assumed this issue is thus separate.

In this case, I have no idea when in the past it started occuring as of this moment. 

### Steps to reproduce

1. Make two new scenes, a loader and a loaded scene
2. put some label in them to see which one is visible
3. attach script to `loader` scene
4. Code a loading loop using `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request` 
5. Run on desktop, web and web_nothreads, web_dlink, web_dlink_nothreads and observe. The only one not working will be web_dlink

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp-threaded-loads.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21555501/mrp-threaded-loads.zip)
